summary: 26-year-old woman: 2 months of a smooth, mobile, non-tender lump in the upper outer right breast; no nipple or skin change.

inputs.hpi: Found a lump in the upper outer right breast two months ago. Smooth, moves under the fingers, not painful, not changed in size or with her periods. No nipple discharge or skin change. No family history of breast cancer.

exam.other: Right breast upper outer quadrant: 2 cm smooth, rubbery, highly mobile, non-tender lump. No skin tethering. Axillae clear.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Probable fibroadenoma
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Smooth mobile breast lump aged 26: probable fibroadenoma; triple assessment.

mustRankTopK.note: Breast frame: smooth, mobile, non-tender lump (web breast_lump, breast_lump_mobile).

guideline.name: NICE NG12 — Suspected cancer: recognition and referral
guideline.section: Lung (1.1), upper GI (1.2), pancreatic (1.2.2), lower GI (1.3) and breast (1.4) cancer referral criteria
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. NICE guideline NG12. London: NICE; 2015 (last updated 2023).

rationale: The breast frame asks site, the lump's character, nipple and skin change — not radiation. A smooth mobile lump at 26 is most likely a fibroadenoma; breast cancer stays on the list.
